# Leads API

33 endpoint(s). Base URL: `${VITE_API_BASE_URL}` (dev: `http://localhost:8003`).

Every request needs `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>` (the token from HRMS login) unless noted otherwise. Response shapes are in [Models](#models) at the bottom. See [README.md](./README.md) for conventions.

---

<a id="get-api-leads"></a>
## `GET /api/leads/`

**Get Leads**

Get list of leads

When date_from and/or date_to are set, leads are filtered by updated_at in that range
(used by domain/region heads and admins to see all statuses in a time period).
assigned_to: list of employee IDs to filter by (leads assigned to any of these).
created_by_me: only leads created by the current user.
include_won_lost: when false (default), leads in Won (is_final) or Lost (is_lost) status are excluded.

**Permission:** `marketing.view_lead`

**Path parameters:** _none_

**Query parameters:**

| name | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | integer | no | (default: `1`) |
| `page_size` | integer | no | (default: `10`) |
| `no_limit` | boolean | no | When true, return all matching leads in one response (used by Kanban). (default: `False`) |
| `status_id` | integer | no | Filter by lead status ID |
| `assigned_to` | integer[] | no | Filter by assigned-to employee ID(s); multiple allowed |
| `created_by_me` | boolean | no | If true, only leads created by the current user (generated by me) (default: `False`) |
| `include_won_lost` | boolean | no | If true, include leads in Won or Lost status; when false (default), exclude them (default: `False`) |
| `lost_only` | boolean | no | If true, only return leads in Lost status (for Orders Lost tab) (default: `False`) |
| `is_hot` | boolean | no | If true, only return leads with hot status (is_hot=True) (default: `False`) |
| `date_from` | string | no | Filter leads updated on or after this date (for admin/heads date range) |
| `date_to` | string | no | Filter leads updated on or before this date (for admin/heads date range) |

**Response** `200` — [`PaginatedResponse<LeadResponse>`](#paginatedresponse-leadresponse)

## `POST /api/leads/`

  "quote_number": "string",
  "next_follow_up_at": "2026-01-31T09:30:00Z",

<a id="post-api-leads-lead-id-activities-activity-id-attachments"></a>
## `POST /api/leads/{lead_id}/activities/{activity_id}/attachments`

**Upload Activity Attachments**

Upload files as quotations (trackable) or general attachments. If series_code is set, quotation numbers are generated: first from series (with lead context), then rev2, rev3 for same activity. If is_revised is true, use the lead's existing quotation base and assign rev2, rev3 (no new number from series).

**Permission:** `marketing.edit_lead`

**Path parameters:**

| name | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lead_id` | integer | yes |  |
| `activity_id` | integer | yes |  |

  "quotation_numbers": "string",
  "titles": "string",

<a id="post-api-leads-lead-id-activities-activity-id-quotations"></a>
## `POST /api/leads/{lead_id}/activities/{activity_id}/quotations`

**Create Quotation Placeholders**

Create file-less quotation rows (pre-generated quotation numbers with no file yet) on an activity.

The user can attach the actual quotation files later via the replace/reattach endpoint,
which preserves each row's quotation_number.

**Permission:** `marketing.edit_lead`

**Path parameters:**

| name | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lead_id` | integer | yes |  |
| `activity_id` | integer | yes |  |

**Request body** (`QuotationPlaceholderCreate`):

```json
{
  "quotation_numbers": [],
  "quote_values": [
    100000
  ],
  "series_code": "string"
}
```

**Response** `201`:

```json
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "activity_id": 1,
    "file_name": "Example name",
    "file_path": "string",
    "is_quotation": false,
    "quotation_number": "string",
    "title": "string",
    "quote_value": 100000,
    "file_size": 20,
    "content_type": "string",
    "media_exists": true,
    "created_at": "2026-01-31T09:30:00Z"
  }
]
```

---

<a id="patch-api-leads-lead-id-follow-up"></a>
## `PATCH /api/leads/{lead_id}/follow-up`

**Schedule Lead Follow Up**

Schedule or clear follow-up reminder for a lead. Assigned user will get a notification at the chosen time.

**Permission:** `marketing.edit_lead`

**Path parameters:**

| name | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lead_id` | integer | yes |  |

**Request body** (`LeadFollowUpSchedule`):

```json
{
  "next_follow_up_at": "2026-01-31T09:30:00Z",
  "follow_up_reminder_type": "string",
  "follow_up_time": "string"
}
```

**Response** `200` — [`LeadResponse`](#leadresponse)

---

<a id="patch-api-leads-lead-id-series"></a>
## `PATCH /api/leads/{lead_id}/series`

**Update Lead Series**

Set or change the lead's number series and assign the next value.
When the lead has no number yet: marketing.edit_lead can set it (generate quote number).
When the lead already has a number: requires marketing.admin to change it.

**Permission:** `marketing.edit_lead`

**Path parameters:**

| name | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lead_id` | integer | yes |  |

**Request body** (`LeadSeriesUpdate`):

```json
{
  "series_code": "string"
}
```

**Response** `200` — [`LeadResponse`](#leadresponse)
